LanguageData.RF_BuddyRewardInfo: A service robot that supplies drinks. Rescue Drinkin' Buddy from the depot and bring him home.
LanguageData.RF_BuddyLost: Drinkin' Buddy did not return home with the rescue party. The rescue has failed.
LanguageData.RF_BuddyEndedFailed: You did not bring Drinkin' Buddy home. The rescue has failed.
LanguageData.RF_BuddyOfferExpired: The depot's broadcast has stopped. You missed this rescue opportunity.
LanguageData.RF_BuddyDepotAbandoned: The rescue party left the depot while Drinkin' Buddy was still sealed inside his pod. The rescue has failed.
LanguageData.RF_BuddyAtDepot: The rescue party has reached the depot. Defeat the guards and have a mechanitor open the pod.
LanguageData.RF_BuddyArrivalLimit: Travel to the depot with a mechanitor who has 1 available bandwidth.
LanguageData.RF_BuddyArrivalRemaining: Travel to the depot with a mechanitor who has 1 available bandwidth.
LanguageData.RF_BuddyReservationLost: The quest encountered a problem and cannot continue. Please check the game log and report this to the mod author.
LanguageData.RF_BuddySiteFailure: The quest encountered a problem and cannot continue. Please check the game log and report this to the mod author.
LanguageData.RF_BuddyDied: Drinkin' Buddy did not make it home safely. The rescue has failed.
LanguageData.RF_BuddyRescueSuccess: Drinkin' Buddy has arrived home. Quest complete.
LanguageData.RF_BuddyGenerationFailure: The quest encountered a problem and cannot continue. Please check the game log and report this to the mod author.
LanguageData.RF_BuddySignalExpired: The rescue party did not arrive in time. The depot's signal has stopped.
LanguageData.RF_BuddyNeedMechanitor: Requires an awake mechanitor who is not downed.
LanguageData.RF_BuddyAlreadyConnected: Drinkin' Buddy is connected. Bring him home.
LanguageData.RF_BuddyUnavailable: Drinkin' Buddy must be alive, standing and inside the depot.
LanguageData.RF_BuddyPodInspect: Drinkin' Buddy is still inside the pod. A mechanitor can open it after the guards are defeated.
LanguageData.RF_BuddyPodDestroyed: The pod was destroyed before Drinkin' Buddy was rescued. The rescue has failed.
LanguageData.RF_BuddyConnectFailed: Could not connect Drinkin' Buddy. Check the mechanitor's condition and available bandwidth. If the problem persists, check the game log and report it to the mod author.
LanguageData.RF_BuddyReleased: Drinkin' Buddy is awake and connected. Add him to your caravan and bring him home.
